gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. All presets off. One-second mesh, native per-frame control priority, handoff ownership event, EDGE cue and RPO request have bounded instruction proofs. Protected integration is in WIRING.md.

input_constraints: Pinned USA XBE or verified composed input; reserve the complete owner union before installing bytes.
At most two authored read plays, bound to exact PLAY/compiler receipt pairs. Empty table is dormant.
RPO receiver must be slot 7 or 8; receiver slot 6 shares the snap button. Native speed options are excluded.
Installed v1/v2 owners require rebuilding from the supported base. An explicit automatic-EDGE table uses snap assignments instead of an authored defender.
portme: Run Noah's I Jokers 155/157, Gun Zone Read 134, hold/release/default give, RPO receiver, live EDGE and lifecycle witness list in ASTRA_READ_OPTION_V3_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute the generated game executable or disc.

runtime.scope: Bounded native per-frame dispatcher replays prove paired final-book lookup, one second of game time, stick priority suppression, give/take initialization, native ownership transfer on the supplied animation event, keep control, and the RPO native throw-request store. Native projection and atlas submission prove the EDGE marker path. Collision-free actor poses, animation timing, asset allocation, post-transfer notifications, GPU submission and aim calculation are fixture inputs or boundaries. Boot, rendered mesh/throw/fake animation and defense remain unwitnessed.

selectors.notes: Two paired authored reads. Hold snap for the whole one-second window to keep; release or no input gives. On RPO, hold snap and press the intended receiver during the window. Left stick waits until the read ends. Supports native I and the supported Gun recipes.
